If you're on this page, you're probably wondering who I am. The answer may depend on what you're looking for... I am a biostatistician and data scientist by training. I work on medical research focused on children's health and vaccine effectiveness. For the past two years I've lived with my partner in Pittsburgh and supported a research team at UMPC Children's. See my [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ray-pomponio) page for more details on what I'm currently up to in my career. You can also find a full bibliography of my published research on [NCBI](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/myncbi/raymond.pomponio.1/bibliography/public/).

I also rock climb, a lot. I've published a few trip reports from various alpine climbing trips across the United States, including in Wyoming, Washington, and Colorado. I am an active member of the [Explorers Club of Pittsburgh](https://pittecp.org/History), which has been an integral part of my adventure life while living in Pittsburgh. I recently became the Rock Climbing Activity Coordinator for the club. I also help out with the Mountaineering School, an advanced instructional course on mountain climbing skills and high-elevation camping.
